primary_metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
uncertainty: Five verified Java SQL paths after a bounded Maven Central search (three queries, 143 hits) and deps.dev direct dependents summed over releases for 11 targeted leads, captured 2026-11-17. org.jooq:jooq 3.21.9 (4,574), com.alibaba:druid 1.2.28 (1,945), com.facebook.presto:presto-parser 0.300 (1,453), org.apache.calcite:calcite-core 1.42.0 (1,250) and com.github.jsqlparser:jsqlparser 5.4 (950) parse both valid controls into their own ASTs, which give the oracle summary. The metrics mostly count other uses for jOOQ (query builder), Druid (JDBC connection pool) and Calcite (planner and adapters), which ship in the same jars, and every value is summed over releases. presto-parser needs DecimalLiteralTreatment.AS_DECIMAL to accept the decimal literal and StatementSplitter to drop the terminating semicolon. The Calcite path pins only the eight jars its parser path loads. Trino and other leads are unverified, so this is not a top-ten ranking. java.sql has no SQL parser. Two valid controls establish only the tested dialect-neutral subset.
